cardiac_coupling.model: four-chamber time-varying elastance + three-element Windkessel (systemic, pulmonary) + compressed intramyocardial coronary branch
cardiac_coupling.ap_model: O'Hara-Rudy 2011 human ventricular myocyte (ORd), endo variant, 41 states, SciPy BDF
cardiac_coupling.pulse_envelope: aortic pressure of beat #2, rescaled to [0.72, 1.27] as a multiplicative modulation of arterial particle speed. The SHAPE is the heart model output; the rescaling range is a display choice and is declared.
cardiac_coupling.data_source: PhysioNet MIT-BIH Normal Sinus Rhythm Database (nsrdb) record 16265 (32 M, 22.24 h) — PUBLIC PLACEHOLDER, NOT THE USER'S OWN DATA
